verdict.rationale: Granola has some operations that act on many notes at once: a one-click CSV export of all historical notes with transcripts and summaries, folder-based automatic sync of notes to HubSpot, and time-based auto-deletion of all transcripts. Chat, the API and MCP can also query and analyze across many calls. However, nothing documents user-driven bulk actions such as selecting many notes to edit, move, tag, share or delete, and the API is described only as read access. Missing for 10: explicit multi-select bulk edit/move/delete actions, documented bulk write endpoints in the API, and hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
